title: Add webapp template: Express server entry point
description: Create the Express v5 server entry point for the server template. Includes JSON middleware, CORS, a health-check GET endpoint, and configurable port from environment variables.
acceptanceCriteria: Server listens on PORT env var with default 3001

steps.details: Create src/templates/webapp/server/src/index.ts: import express from 'express'; import cors from 'cors'; const app = express(); const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001; app.use(express.json()); app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.CLIENT_URL || 'http://localhost:5173' })); app.get('/api/health', (_req, res) => { res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }); }); app.listen(PORT, () => { console.log(`Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`); }); export default app;

steps.description: Verify the template is syntactically correct
steps.details: Review the template file for TypeScript syntax errors. The file should compile cleanly (ignoring missing imports that would be in node_modules of the scaffolded project).

technicalNotes: Express v5 has different error handling signatures than v4 — async route handlers auto-catch errors
The CORS origin should be configurable via env var to support different environments
